lines.en: label cafe15:
scene cafe_day
: Next customer, please!
lines.zh: : 下一位顾客，请！

lines.en: scene cafe1
: Oh hey, Sensei. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 哦嘿，Sensei。怎么了？

lines.en: : Morning, Rin. Just stopping by to play my weekly game of coffee-roulette.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Rin。我就是过来玩我每周一次的咖啡轮盘赌。

lines.en: scene cafe4
: Well, you’re in luck because I’m actually about to clock out.
lines.zh: : 那你还挺走运的，因为我正准备打卡下班。

lines.en: : Already? Are you getting your hours cut or something?
lines.zh: : 已经？你的工时被砍了还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene cafe6
: Huh? No, it’s nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 哈？不是，完全不是那么回事。

lines.en: : Haruka would never cut my hours. I’m too good at this stuff.
lines.zh: : Haruka 才不会砍我的工时。我干这个太拿手了。

lines.en: : So good that I have {i}two{/i} shifts, actually. I just need to clock out between them for a doctor's appointment.
lines.zh: : 拿手到我有{i}两个{/i}班，其实。我只是需要在两个班中间打卡出去，去看个医生。

lines.en: scene cafe4
: But, hey! Drop by again later and you can get all the Rin you want!
lines.zh: : 不过，嘿！晚点再来一趟，你想要多少 Rin 就有多少！

lines.en: : A doctor’s appointment? Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 看医生？出什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene cafe3
: Oh, nah. It's no big deal. Just some...check-up sorta thing. You don’t need to worry about it.
lines.zh: : 哦，没有。没什么大不了的。就是……检查一下什么的。你不用担心。

lines.en: : Well, I'm not going to try and get involved where I'm not welcome. Hope it goes well, though.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我不会硬往不欢迎我的地方凑。不过希望一切顺利。

lines.en: scene cafe4
: I'm sure it will!
lines.zh: : 我肯定会的！

lines.en: : So, what can I get for you today, sir?
lines.zh: : 那么，今天您要点什么呢，先生？

lines.en: : I appreciate that you still ask even though we both know you aren’t going to listen.
lines.zh: : 我很感激你还在问，尽管我们都知道你根本不会照做。

lines.en: : Just doing my job, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我只是在做我的工作，Sensei！

lines.en: Are you really, though?...
lines.zh: 你真的在做吗？……

lines.en: scene black
I choose a random drink off of the menu and prepare myself for whatever it is Rin will be making for me today.
lines.zh: 我从菜单上随便挑了一杯饮料，做好了面对 Rin 今天会给我调出什么东西的心理准备。

lines.en: Considering that her last drink wasn't as solid as the preceding ones, I'm thinking that this time-
lines.zh: 考虑到她上一杯不如之前那几杯稳，我在想这次——

lines.en: : Done!
lines.zh: : 好了！

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux1
: What? Already? But I haven't even sat down yet.
lines.zh: : 什么？已经好了？可我还没坐下呢。

lines.en: : Yup! Here ya go! One cafe mocha!
lines.zh: : 对！给您！一杯咖啡摩卡！

lines.en: : Like...a normal cafe mocha? With nothing weird about it?
lines.zh: : 就是……普通的咖啡摩卡？没有奇怪的地方？

lines.en: : Did you just have one left over from another customer or something?
lines.zh: : 你是别的客人剩了一杯还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Nope. Just the greatest barista in the world working extra hard to deliver quality beverages to her favorite teacher.
lines.zh: : 不是。只是全世界最棒的咖啡师格外努力，给她最喜欢的老师奉上优质饮品而已。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Are you dying or something?
lines.zh: : 你是不是要死了之类的？

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux2
: What? Of course not. I told you it was just a check-up.
lines.zh: : 什么？当然不是。我说了只是检查一下。

lines.en: : Then why are you giving me a normal drink? Have I done something to offend you?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么给我一杯正常的饮料？我做什么冒犯你的事了吗？

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux3
: No...it's not like that. I just wasn't really feeling creative today.
lines.zh: : 不是……不是那样的。我只是今天不太有创作欲。

lines.en: : But if you really want, I can go dump a bunch of stuff into a cup and see how that comes out instead. Just didn't wanna give you something I couldn't put my heart into, you know?
lines.zh: : 不过你要是真想，我可以往杯子里倒一堆东西，看看能出什么。只是不想给你一杯我没法倾注心意的东西，你懂吧？

lines.en: : I don't think that's necessary. I'm just a little surprised to see you going through such a slump.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没那个必要。我只是有点意外，你居然会陷入这种低谷。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux4
: A...slump?
: Maybe that's not the right word for it. You've just seemed a little out of sorts lately.
lines.zh: : 也许这个词不太对。你最近看起来只是有点不在状态。

lines.en: : Out of sorts?
lines.zh: : 不在状态？

lines.en: : Besides, I thought you loved making weird drinks and laughing silently to yourself as I test them before anyone else.
lines.zh: : 再说，我以为你最喜欢调奇怪的饮料，然后在别人之前让我试喝的时候，自己偷偷笑。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux5
: I do, though. Just not today, okay?
lines.zh: : 我是喜欢啊。只是今天不行，好吗？

lines.en: : You know you can talk to me if-
lines.zh: : 你知道你可以跟我说，如果——

lines.en: : Didn't I like, just tell you the other day that I was fine? You don’t have to worry about me, Sensei. Really.
lines.zh: : 我不是前几天刚跟你说过我没事吗？你不用为我担心，Sensei。真的。

lines.en: : It’s not just me, though. Chika is worrying about you too.
lines.zh: : 可不只我一个人。Chika 也在担心你。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux6
: Wait...what? Chika is...worrying about {i}me?{/i} Are you sure? What if she was talking about another Rin?
lines.zh: : 等等……什么？Chika 在……担心{i}我{/i}？你确定？万一她说的是另一个 Rin 呢？

lines.en: : I really don't think she was.
lines.zh: : 我真的不觉得她是。

lines.en: : But why? Like, how does she even know something is wrong?
lines.zh: : 可为什么？比如，她到底是怎么知道有什么不对劲的？

lines.en: : I thought nothing was wrong?
lines.zh: : 我以为没什么不对劲？

lines.en: : Yeah, that. That's what I meant to say. Why does she think that something is wrong?
lines.zh: : 对，就是这个。我就是想说这个。她为什么会觉得有什么不对劲？

lines.en: : Because you keep getting all weird around her.
lines.zh: : 因为你一在她身边就变得怪怪的。

lines.en: : She's noticed that you haven't been acting like yourself and seems to think it might be her fault.
lines.zh: : 她注意到你最近不像你自己了，而且似乎觉得那可能是她的错。

lines.en: : She thinks...it's {i}her{/i} fault?
lines.zh: : 她觉得……是{i}她{/i}的错？

lines.en: : That’s not the case though, is it?
lines.zh: : 可事实不是那样吧？

lines.en: : Of course that's not the case. It's just...
lines.zh: : 当然不是那样。只是……

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux7
: Hah...
I decide to let Rin stay quiet for a little while as she figures out the best way to talk about this.
lines.zh: 我决定让 Rin 安静一会儿，让她想清楚该怎么说这件事。

lines.en: When she remains quiet for an uncomfortable amount of time, though, I decide it might be best to provide a little positive reinforcement...
lines.zh: 不过当她沉默的时间久到让人不自在时，我决定最好给一点正面鼓励……

lines.en: : Take your time, Rin.
lines.zh: : 慢慢来，Rin。

lines.en: : I’m not going anywhere anytime soon. So if you-
lines.zh: : 我短时间内哪儿都不会去。所以如果你——

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux8
: Sensei, do you ever have any thoughts that you wish you didn’t?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你有没有过那种，希望自己没有过的念头？

lines.en: : What do you mean exactly?...
lines.zh: : 你具体是指什么？……

lines.en: : You know. Like, stuff that pops into your head that you realize shouldn’t be there but, like...
lines.zh: : 你知道的。就像，脑子里突然冒出来的东西，你意识到它不该在那儿，可是……

lines.en: : You can’t really do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 你又拿它没办法。

scene cafemocharedux8
: I guess I do sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我想我偶尔会有吧。

lines.en: else:
scene whygodwhy
scene cafemocharedux8
: Maybe every now and then, sure.
lines.zh: : 偶尔，也许吧，大概。

lines.en: : Okay.
: Good.
lines.zh: : 那就好。

lines.en: : Well, {i}not{/i} good. But I’m at least glad that I’m not the only one it happens to.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}不{/i}是好。但至少我很高兴不是只有我一个人会这样。

lines.en: : Do you want to talk about what you’re-
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊你在——

lines.en: : Not really. But thanks.
lines.zh: : 不太想。不过谢谢。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux1
: You know what? Why don't we just talk about something else?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我们何不换个话题？

lines.en: scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy3
scene cafemocharedux9
: {b}Like the inevitable collapse of our relationship when you start fucking the girl I habitually touch myself to.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}比如当你开始肏那个我习惯性对着自慰的女孩时，我们这段关系不可避免的崩塌。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}Or the ever present, looming darkness bubbling up inside of us. Expanding in size until it's brave enough to crawl through our throats.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}又比如那团一直在我们体内翻涌、始终笼罩着我们的黑暗。它不断膨胀，直到有胆量从我们的喉咙里爬出来。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}Frothing like the foam atop a cafe mocha.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}像咖啡摩卡上的奶泡一样冒着沫。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}A window of the waking mind, thick with saliva and the remnants of days gone by.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}清醒心智的一扇窗，糊满唾液与逝去日子的残骸。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}Why don't we talk about that?{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我们何不聊聊那个？{/b}

lines.en: : {b}Or better yet-{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}或者更好——{/b}

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux10
: why dont we talk about nothing
lines.zh: : 我们何不什么都不聊

IF I TOLD YOU THE ANSWER, WOULD YOU EVEN BELIEVE ME???

lines.en: OR WOULD YOU RATHER THE DREAMS REMAIN???
lines.zh: 还是你宁愿让梦继续？？？

lines.en: SHE HURTS WHILE SHE WAITS
lines.zh: 她在等待中受苦

lines.en: HER BODY IS FULL OF NEW GUINEA FLATWORMS
lines.zh: 她的身体里满是新的几内亚扁虫

lines.en: GIVE HER WHAT SHE WANTS
lines.zh: 给她想要的东西

lines.en: FILL HER WITH YOUR CUM
lines.zh: 用你的精液填满她

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux13
: {s}Why won’t you tell me what's wrong with you?{/s} Sure. What would you like to talk about instead?
lines.zh: : {s}为什么你不肯告诉我你到底怎么了？{/s} 好啊。那你想聊点什么？

lines.en: : Thanks, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Sensei……

lines.en: : And, umm...this is probably pretty predictable...but since we're already on the topic...
lines.zh: : 还有，嗯……这个大概挺好猜的……不过既然我们已经聊到这儿了……

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux14
: Did...Chika say anything else about me?
lines.zh: : Chika……还说过我别的什么吗？

lines.en: : Hmm...Well, it’s not like we really had a lot of time to talk when you were only gone for a couple of minutes.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你也就离开了几分钟，我们其实也没多少时间聊。

lines.en: : But like...she hasn't said anything about me apart from when the three of us were here together?
lines.zh: : 可是……除了我们三个在这儿那次之外，她就没再提过我什么吗？

lines.en: : Not really. Nothing worth mentioning, at least.
lines.zh: : 真没有。至少没什么值得一提的。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux15
: UGH. Fuck my life.
lines.zh: : 呃。操蛋的人生。

lines.en: : So...how long have you had a crush on her?
lines.zh: : 那么……你喜欢她多久了？

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux16
: Hah...Was only a matter of time until you figured it out.
lines.zh: : 哈……你迟早会发现的。

lines.en: : I had a feeling ever since I caught you staring at her in the hallway. What I didn't know was how long you've felt this way.
lines.zh: : 自从我撞见你在走廊上盯着她看，我就有预感了。我不知道的是，你这份心思持续多久了。

lines.en: : I literally have not stopped thinking about her for like two years.
lines.zh: : 我大概整整两年没有一刻不在想她。

lines.en: : Interesting choice, Rin.
lines.zh: : 有意思的选择，Rin。

lines.en: : I mean, Chika’s definitely cute. She just seems like the complete polar opposite of you.
lines.zh: : 我是说，Chika 确实可爱。只是她看起来跟你完全是两个极端。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux8
: I mean, she’s not {i}that{/i} different, is she? We’re both girls and we both...like...you know...
lines.zh: : 我是说，她没{i}那么{/i}不一样吧？我们都是女生，而且我们都……喜欢……你知道的……

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux6
: Holy shit. We’re nothing alike, are we?
lines.zh: : 我操。我们一点都不像，对吧？

lines.en: : Did...that really not ever occur to you?
lines.zh: : 这个……你真的一次都没意识到吗？

lines.en: : Not even once.
lines.zh: : 一次都没有。

lines.en: How?...
lines.zh: 怎么会？……

lines.en: : Either way, I’m glad it's finally out in the open.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我很高兴这件事终于说开了。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux17
: Let's...not use the word {i}open{/i} just yet. Because if you leak this to anyone, I will chop your body in half and feed it to sharks.
lines.zh: : 我们……先别用「说{i}开{/i}」这个词。因为你要是泄露给任何人，我就把你砍成两半喂鲨鱼。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : Oh, and don’t try and steal her from me either! I see the way you look at her sometimes!
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，你也别想从我身边把她抢走！我有时候都看到你看她的眼神了！

lines.en: if chikatownfirst == True:
Yeah...it might be a little too late for that.
lines.zh: 是啊……这个可能有点太迟了。

lines.en: else:
I don’t think I’ve looked at Chika any differently than the others?...
lines.zh: 我想我看 Chika 的眼神并没有跟别人有什么不同？……

lines.en: : I'll stay away, but...do you even know if she's into girls?
lines.zh: : 我会躲远点，不过……你到底知不知道她喜不喜欢女生？

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux18
: You're really killing my vibes today, Sensei. I don't appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 你今天真是扫兴透了，Sensei。我可不喜欢。

lines.en: : I think what I asked was a pretty decent question, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我问的问题相当合理吧，Rin。

lines.en: : All girls are at least {i}kind of{/i} into other girls! I mean...come on!
lines.zh: : 所有女生至少都{i}有点{/i}喜欢别的女生！我是说……拜托！

lines.en: : Have you {i}seen{/i} girls? How can you not be?!
lines.zh: : 你{i}见过{/i}女生吗？怎么可能不喜欢？！

lines.en: : But even if she pretends she isn't! Keep your hands to yourself until she properly rejects me!
lines.zh: : 就算她假装不喜欢！在她正式拒绝我之前，把你的手给我安分点！

lines.en: if chikadorm20 == True:
I obviously can't find it in myself to tell Rin that Chika and I are already a little more than just friends.
lines.zh: 我显然没法开口告诉 Rin，我和 Chika 已经不止是朋友了。

lines.en: But even if Rin had come to me with this request before all that, would it have changed anything?
lines.zh: 不过就算 Rin 在那之前就来找我提这个要求，事情会有什么不同吗？

lines.en: When have I ever allowed my choices to be guided by the hands of others?
lines.zh: 我什么时候允许过自己的选择被别人的手牵着走？

lines.en: Chika and Rin have known each other for a long time now.
lines.zh: Chika 和 Rin 已经认识很久了。

lines.en: If anything was going to happen...
lines.zh: 如果真会有什么……

lines.en: Well, I think it would have happened already.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想早就该发生了。

lines.en: : Are you actually planning on asking her out?
lines.zh: : 你真的打算约她出去吗？

lines.en: : Well...yeah. Eventually.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是的。迟早。

lines.en: : I just don't know when.
lines.zh: : 我只是不知道什么时候。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux19
: What?! Stop judging me! I’ve never done something like this before! I don’t know what the correct order to do things in is!
lines.zh: : 什么？！别评判我了！我从没做过这种事！我不知道做这些事的正确顺序是什么！

lines.en: : And like you said, I don’t even know if she’s into girls yet! Let alone {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 而且就像你说的，我连她喜不喜欢女生都还不知道！更别说喜不喜欢{i}我{/i}了。

lines.en: : She’s probably just being friendly with me like she is with literally everyone else but my stupid brain is all like “AHHH CHIKA!” or whatever.
lines.zh: : 她大概对谁都那么亲切，跟对其他所有人一样，可我那蠢脑子就一直「啊——CHIKA！」之类的。

lines.en: : This sounds a little more serious than just a normal crush.
lines.zh: : 这听起来比普通的暗恋要认真多了。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux8
: I have an actual folder of her Instagram photos saved on my laptop.
lines.zh: : 我笔记本电脑里真的存着一个她 Instagram 照片的文件夹。

lines.en: : You...do realize that's essentially stalking, right?
lines.zh: : 你……知道这基本上就是在跟踪吧？

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. I'm nice. Stalkers aren’t normally nice. Probably.
lines.zh: : 才不是。我很友善的。跟踪狂一般不友善。大概吧。

lines.en: : I'm sure some are. But I'm not one of them. Probably.
lines.zh: : 我肯定有些是友善的。但我不是那种人。大概吧。

lines.en: : You can't just keep adding {i}probably{/i} to the ends of sentences to dodge blame, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你不能老是在句子末尾加{i}大概吧{/i}来逃避责任，Rin。

lines.en: : Sure I can. Probably.
lines.zh: : 我当然能。大概吧。

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux20
: Rin, you can head out now! I’ve got it from here. And thanks again for coming in to open.
lines.zh: : Rin，你可以走了！这里我来。还有，谢谢你今天过来开门。

lines.en: : No prob, Haruka! I’ll be back later! Probably!
lines.zh: : 没问题，Haruka！我晚点回来！大概吧！

lines.en: : Wait, what do you mean probably?
lines.zh: : 等等，「大概吧」是什么意思？

lines.en: scene cafemocharedux1
: I guess I’ll...see you later, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那我……回头见，Sensei。

lines.en: : Rin, seriously! What did you mean by that?
lines.zh: : Rin，认真的！你那话到底什么意思？

lines.en: : And sorry if I've been acting weird and making you worry lately. I really do appreciate that you're looking out for me.
lines.zh: : 还有，对不起我最近表现得怪怪的，害你担心。你这么关心我，我真的很感激。

lines.en: : I'm sure I'll be back to normal in no time at all and you'll be free to become my {s}NEW GUINEA FLATWORM{/s} guinea pig once more.
lines.zh: : 我肯定很快就会恢复正常，到时候你就可以继续拿我当{s}新几内亚扁虫{/s}小白鼠了。

lines.en: : Sounds good. Best of luck with your check-up.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错。祝你检查顺利。

lines.en: : Gracias, mi amigo. ¡Adiós!
lines.zh: : Gracias, mi amigo. ¡Adiós!

lines.en: scene black
Rin quickly grabs her bag from behind the counter and rushes out of the cafe.
lines.zh: Rin 迅速从柜台后面抓起包，冲出了咖啡馆。

lines.en: I watch her jog down the street toward the bus stop and decide it’s best to stay inside for a little while longer so I don't have to awkwardly pass by her again.
lines.zh: 我看着她沿街跑向公交站，决定在屋里再待一会儿，省得又要尴尬地和她擦身而过。

lines.en: Or at least that's what I intend to do before the thought of her and Chika together forces me into the bathroom for several minutes before I decide to go home.
lines.zh: 至少我是这么打算的——直到脑海里浮现出她和 Chika 在一起的画面，逼得我在洗手间里待了好几分钟，然后才决定回家。
